measure: vacancies registered with the BA per 1,000 registered unemployed, per Kreis
source: Statistik der Bundesagentur für Arbeit: Gemeldete Arbeitsstellen und Arbeitslose nach Kreisen (statistik.arbeitsagentur.de); eigene Berechnungen
notice: Vacancies per 1,000 unemployed, the ranking and the year-on-year ratio are own calculations by germany-job-ease-index, not figures published by the BA.

not_ranked.reason: Köln's vacancy stock (44,350 in Oct 2026, 10,340 a year earlier) includes many Bundeswehr posts advertised for all of Germany, so it doesn't describe jobs in Köln (source: https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/vor-ort/koeln/presse/2026-22-herbstbelebung-bleibt-schwunglos)
